perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Mastercard Wallet Pay remains the freshest material primary expansion signal: named wallet partners span NFC, QR and online payments, but partner breadth is not proof of scaled transaction economics.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Distribution potential is credible; transaction ramp, incremental revenue and margin remain unproven and should not be inferred from launch breadth.

lineage.searchStrategy: cumulative evidence reused; no repeated low-value search after prior freshness check found no material displacement
